title: Altimeter Exits All CoreWeave Stakes for 3 Year Low in AI Exposure

tickers.name: CoreWeave, Inc. Class A Common Stock
Meta Platforms, Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
Brad Gerstner has stripped Altimeter Capital of its entire position in CoreWeave after concluding that artificial intelligence valuations have overshot their reasonable limit. During a CNBC appearance, Gerstner stated the firm has reduced overall AI exposure over the past 3 months, rotating 10% of the fund's book into Meta and Tesla. The exit follows an August 14 filing showing Altimeter held 6 million CoreWeave shares as of June 30, including 1.5 million shares added during the second quarter.

The fund's AI holdings are now at the lowest levels they have been in 3 years, Gerstner told the network. This liquidation has drawn criticism from market observers who note a disconnect between the fund's actual trading activity and Gerstner's continued public promotion of AI technologies.
